Definition
[normal coordinates and normal frame at $p$]

Source: petersen:page-0074 ↗ def:pet-ch2-riemannian-connection

A coordinate system is normal at $p$ if $g_{ij}|_p=\delta _{ij}$ and $\partial _kg_{ij}|_p=0$. An orthonormal frame $E_1,\dots ,E_n$ is normal at $p$ if $(\nabla _vE_i)|_p=0$ for all $i$ and $v\in T_pM$. Such coordinates and frames always exist at every point.
